capabilities: Translate complete PDF pages with vision-capable, OpenAI-compatible models
Highlight corresponding source and translated sentences on hover
Summarize papers and answer focused questions in an AI assistant panel
Cache page translations and summaries in the plugin directory
Read PDFs in a resizable outline, reader, translation, and assistant workspace
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a data and privacy section explaining that no telemetry is collected and requests go only to the user-configured endpoint.
intentEvidence: The goal is to provide an open-source option for users who want a similar integrated paper-reading workflow inside Obsidian
motivation: The author wanted an open-source option for users who want a similar integrated paper-reading workflow inside Obsidian, implemented independently of Moonlight.
problem: Obsidian lacks an integrated way to read academic PDFs with reliable translation that preserves equations, layout, and sentence-level source alignment.

relations.evidence: inspired by aspects of the academic PDF reading workflow found in Moonlight

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint with vision/image input support

summary: Academic PDF reader that produces vision-assisted, layout-aware page translations with source alignment and a paper-aware AI assistant.
